title: Words rise (HyperFrames block)
description: Each word rises out of its own mask, one after another, and the last word is gold (GSAP SplitText with masks). A HyperFrames-format block played as it is; the canvas grows with the sentence so it fills the width.

source.note: our own block in the HyperFrames format; blocks from heygen-com/hyperframes (Apache-2.0) run the same way

props.text: required, 2-5 words; the last one is gold
